# Suman Krishna — AI/ML & Flutter Engineer Portfolio

## Who is Suman Krishna?

Suman Krishna is a final-year B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at CT Institute of Engineering, Management & Technology (CTIEMT), Jalandhar, Punjab, India (2023–2027). He specialises in Machine Learning, Deep Learning (NLP & Computer Vision), cross-platform Flutter development, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

He is a Google Student Ambassador, GDG Member, and holds 7× NASSCOM FutureSkills Prime Gold Certifications — including AWS Cloud (100%), Generative AI 101 (100%), and Prompt Engineering (96%).

## Key Projects (12 total)

1. **AIHire** — Autonomous AI recruitment and candidate evaluation platform (LLMs, FastAPI, React, Docker)
2. **CT Group KRA & KPI System** — Cross-platform Flutter appraisal app for CT Group of Institutions (1,000-mark RBAC system)
3. **CT Events** — College event management app with Firebase, QR check-in, and push notifications
4. **CT E-Pass** — Digital gate-pass and visitor management system with QR validation and real-time audit logs
5. **AI Document Assistant** — RAG-powered document chat using LangChain, FAISS, and Gemini API
6. **Multimodal Depression Detection** — BERT + Wav2Vec 2.0 + ResNet-LSTM late fusion model on USC DAIC-WOZ
7. **Plant Disease Recognition** — CNN trained on 54,000+ PlantVillage images, ~95% accuracy, Flask deployed
8. **Superstore BI Suite** — 4-page Power BI dashboard with 25+ DAX measures on 50,000+ records
9. **Career Guidance AI** — Gradient-boosted recommendation engine for career path prediction
10. **Air Pollution Health Risk Analysis** — Epidemiological time-series analysis of PM2.5, PM10, NOx
11. **Dual Wired & Bluetooth Robotic Car** — Arduino Uno + L298N + HC-05, embedded C++ firmware
12. **J.A.R.V.I.S.** — Voice-activated desktop assistant with intent parsing and OS automation
